protocol.neural: Matched 39-epoch reference plus separate lower-learning-rate and higher-weight-decay controls; retain task-weighted loss, architecture, inputs and seed. Monitor the current full ensemble, replacing only the weighted Transformer component.
protocol.lgb: Add only the two existing temporal ranks. First train 1499 trees to match the 2021 incumbent; all other features and parameters unchanged.
protocol.selection: Choose direct replacement or fixed 50/50 old/new component mean by 2021 full-ensemble AUC before checking 2022. No fallback variant switch after later-year results.
protocol.confirmation: Positive 2021 screen followed by a positive frozen-2022 Jan7+ gate before native-2022 refitting. Native and frozen 2022 use the same labels and are not independent replications. Both years are reused development data.
protocol.neural_counts: Freeze the 2021 selected checkpoint epoch for native-2022 and full-data fitting; no 2022 early stopping.
protocol.lgb_2022_count: Native 2022 and full-data rank models use 800 trees, matching existing no-rank models; 2021/frozen comparisons use 1499 to match existing pre-2021 model. Before any candidate 2022 score, require positive 2021 ensemble delta both at matched 1499 and matched 800-tree prefixes. Selection of replacement versus old/new mean is based on 2021 only.
protocol.combination: Combine only individually accepted changes. Select any combination on 2021 before reporting reused-2022 results; no additional weight search.
protocol.neural_advancement: Before any candidate 2022 score, compare each optimizer arm and matched reference using its 2021-selected checkpoint and the two predeclared variants. Advance at most the highest-scoring optimizer arm, only if its 2021 ensemble score exceeds both the unchanged incumbent and the best matched-reference variant. If neither optimizer qualifies but the reference improves, test that separately as checkpoint reselection. Do not switch to a runner-up after seeing 2022.
